data.summary:
Results-driven EWM Consultant with over 3.2 years of hands-on experience in implementing and supporting SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) solutions. Adept at optimizing warehouse processes, improving inventory accuracy, and enhancing overall supply chain efficiency.
Exceptional problem-solving abilities and strong analytical skills with a commitment to continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.
Proven track record of successfully managing end-to-end EWM projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering high-quality solutions on time.
Working in Accenture from December 2021 to Feb 2024 as          Business and Technology Delivery Associate.
Currently working in Accenture from March 2024 to till date as Business Architecture Analyst.
Handled 2 Successful Go-lives, cutover, hyper care, production issues. FUT, SIT, UAT.
Got recognized and received Accenture Celebrates Excellence Award for successful implementation of warehouse in Feb’2023. ​​
Our project was honoured with Prestigious SAP ACE Award 2024.

raw_sections.experience:
Experience 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
EWM Consultant [Bausch + Lomb], [Sept/2024] – Present
Supporting in incident solving by analysing incidents raised by users and providing solutions.
Business clean-up activity. Clearing queues.
IDOC monitoring.
Working closely with users & teams to ensure issues and requests are addressed timely.
Solving test cases in ALM tool.
Cross-functional communication skills with working with SAP SD and SAP MM teams.
Understands Business needs and delivers solutions.
Flexible in managing work hours, working in shifts and giving on call support for critical business requirements.
EWM Consultant [ SAKATA INX], [Aug/2023] - [Sept/2024]
Prepared Business Process Documents in English as well as in Japanese languages & Prepared User-Manuals.
Data Migration done with EWM stock upload in system.
Completed and maintained Cutover activities required for Go-live.
Maintained EWM Master data like Work Centers, PSAs, Condition Records, EWM Resources, Product Master, Pack Spec, SCU Master, Storage bins and bins sorting, etc.
SIT, UAT, UAT-2 with functions of Inbound, Outbound, STO, SO, PO deliveries.
EWM Consultant [ Aditya Birla Fashion Retail Ltd ], [June/2022] - [Aug/2023]
I was part of the Inbound and Internal Movements functional team responsible for RF and Put away and Cycle counting. And handled E-COMM, Trade, Retail, Inbound which involves Configuration, FUT and Extensive SIT​.​
Prepared Business Process Documents & Functional Spec Development of complex custom RF developments. Testing, UAT Support, Deploy & PGLS.  & Prepared User-Manuals.
Has good analytical skills and good knowledge with basic nodes and their usage in EWM.​
Extensive support in critical time and flexible enough to complete deliverables on time. ​
On site warehouse hyper-care support in go-live with user trainings to warehouse staff.​
